# Art credits

Every motif used on a screen has a credit line. The line names the artist or the source. Where the source is a tradition, the tradition is named. No person's name is invented. No licence is invented. EXT-14 has not returned, so every sign-off below is Pending.

## Used on a screen

### Ink Lesson, Next lesson row

| field | entry |

| screens | Today light and Today dark, Ink Lesson |
| surface | The Next lesson row only, under `Ẹ kú àárọ̀` |

| source | Yoruba adire resist-dye tradition |
| why this source | The unit is a Yoruba morning greeting |
| artist | not contracted, and no person is named |

The minute pill, the due-review row, the speaking row, and Start carry no motif.

### Courtyard

No craft motif is drawn on the Courtyard Today frames. There is no credit line for a use, because there is no motif on the screen. Sign-off for the direction remains Pending.

### Night Study

No craft motif is drawn on the Night Study Today frames. The curve above the greeting is an orthographic tone shape in the text color. It is not a borrowed motif and not an artist's work. Sign-off for the direction remains Pending.
